## Summary

Fixes #3714. A structurally valid, authorized, currently-owned bulk response start that exceeds its receive budget now rejects only that request with `response_too_large`; unrelated requests and subscriptions retain the same link.

The only production change is the explicitly grouped size predicate in the existing `rejectStart` branch, using `pending.path`. Both alternatives remain beneath all response/type/direction/request/current-pending gates. The existing matching cancel occurs before credit or incoming body allocation and releases the sender response/transfer slot. Writes remain indeterminate; completed-write history is retained and nothing is automatically retried.

## Changes and security boundary

Parser, pin/authority, fresh-token ledger, metadata/count/same-operation checks, `accept`, bulk lane, route/frame caps and the attachment-request branch are unchanged. Malformed/unknown/stale-owner, pin/capability, token/replay/count/integrity/credit failures retain their existing fatal paths. Existing tombstone-owned late drops are preserved, not generalized oversized-message tolerance.

No route/grant/permission/phone field, alternate-route fallback, federation422 disposition, Details/Naming writer, production handoff, timeout or workflow change. Directly related desktop binary documentation is updated.
